node_definition.done_when: Tests with a temporary repository and crew home show the following: A plan with five implementable sections, two of them waiting on a third, gives three queued rows and two awaiting-upstream rows from one call. A second identical call queues nothing and skips all five, naming the runs. A done section and a deferred section are skipped with those reasons. A section with no done-when is refused on its row while the others queue. A section with a live run of another session is skipped naming that session. Negative control: the five-section call against the base revision is refused for naming no section, and the failing run is logged. The gate runs on all_debug , and its log is written to docs/evidence/fragments/building-a-plan-queues-all-of-it/s2.html .
